clusters.headline: Political Response And Economic Outlook Following Gibran Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly of Indonesia is conducting joint meetings to establish a verification team for a new vice presidential candidate.
Economic officials have stated that national targets and investment climates should remain stable provided the political transition is managed in an orderly fashion.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Coalition Parties Prepare Vice President Nominations
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto has requested coalition parties to propose potential candidates for the vice presidency within one week.
The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) has officially scheduled the selection process for the new vice president to take place on December 2.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Confers Honors On Forest Fire Response Personnel
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto awarded Bintang Jasa honors to 23 volunteers and health workers injured or killed during forest fire missions.
The government has committed to ensuring the welfare and future of the families affected by the incidents.

clusters.headline: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Faces Leadership Dispute Amid Changes
aiSummaryBullets: The Federasi Futsal Indonesia is undergoing a period of internal instability following the removal of its Secretary General.
Officials have confirmed that the national futsal team operations will remain unaffected by the current organizational conflict.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto To Attend Muhammadiyah Event In Palu
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is scheduled to attend the Tanwir Muhammadiyah event in Palu, Central Sulawesi.
The gathering coincides with the 114th anniversary of the Muhammadiyah organization.

clusters.headline: Authorities Investigate Fatal Tower Crane Collapse In Mega Kuningan
aiSummaryBullets: A construction crane collapsed at a hotel project site in the Mega Kuningan district of South Jakarta on Friday.
The incident resulted in the death of one construction worker.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Junior Badminton Players Advance To International Finals
aiSummaryBullets: Farel Fadhilah Ukasyah qualified for the boys' singles final in the U17 category.
Raisya Affatunisa secured a spot in the girls' singles final at the tournament.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Outlines Energy Transition Strategy At Global Forums
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia introduced a new energy transition toolkit during the COP31 conference held in Antalya.
The Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly reaffirmed the nation's commitment to energy shifts at the Global Finance Summit.

clusters.headline: Pelita Air Awards Customers As BYD Faces Government Scrutiny
aiSummaryBullets: Pelita Air awarded three electric cars to customers with the highest transaction values during its High Spender loyalty program.
Minister of Industry Sarmuji visited the new BYD facility in Subang to address local employment concerns following community protests.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Prepares For Upcoming Guns N' Roses And BTS Performances
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung expects major international concerts to bolster local tourism and economic activity.
City authorities will extend operating hours for public transportation, including MRT, LRT, and TransJakarta, to accommodate concert attendees.
